mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions and a temperature of 70 degrees near Verona City Hall. Under clear skies tonight starting at 5:02 PM, you can catch the International Space Station rising low near the horizon from Middleton near Verona High School and moving toward Madison near Home Depot.

City property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th. The first installment is due January 31st to the City Treasurer, and the second is due July 31st to the Dane County Treasurer. Payments can be completed online via BS&A, by mail, in person, or using the 24/7 drop boxes at City Center.
Looking at local events, you can test your trivia knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia today. Tomorrow, enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness or catch Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In police news, officers investigated a two-vehicle crash in a parking lot on Wednesday, November 4th, resulting in the arrest of a 34-year-old driver for an O W I with a passenger under 16.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, serving up OREO REESE'S Cheesecake as today's flavor of the day.
